data.body: Author-side review remediation complete at exact commit f4af25a2fbc99eab127a5ee9f23200af2f46da3d, retaining Change-Id Ia9881648a93b3ff9aa5305c6925dbb5005fc257a. The split-JQL module docstring no longer claims deduplication coverage; it accurately states that distinct fixture prefixes keep the ordering/cap tests separate from cross-query deduplication. Relative to the reviewed failing SHA, only that allowtere listed docstring changed. Exact eight-path scope, diff integrity, comment hygiene, scoped Ruff/format, canonical ticket trailer, and the 26 focused tests pass; the amend hook passed repository lint and typecheck. Per operator direction, no full suite was run. This new patchset has not been pushed and requires a fresh independent exact-SHA 24-row review first.
